prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: production mobile app launcher icon for RacingClub, an equestrian route puzzle game. One square 1024 x 1024 master image, full bleed and fully opaque.
Primary request: a warm, polished, instantly recognizable icon that matches a storybook horse arena game with wooden route tiles, cream paths and forest-green controls.
Subject: one beautiful chestnut horse with flowing dark mane in a clear energetic side-profile jump over one simple cream-and-forest-green equestrian hurdle, standing above a single small honey-colored wooden route tile. Keep the horse silhouette bold, graceful and readable at 48 pixels. Horse is the hero, no rider. Integrate a simple curved cream route into the tile, with restrained detail.
Style/medium: premium hand-painted 3D storybook game icon, gently bevelled wooden material, warm golden highlights, clean silhouette and strong contrast, sophisticated and friendly rather than babyish.
Scene/backdrop: rich deep forest green edge-to-edge background, very subtle green tonal depth, no scenery, no frame. Keep outer corners completely filled with green.
Composition/framing: balanced centered emblem. ALL horse, hurdle and tile details fit within the central 64% of the canvas so Android adaptive circular and squircle masks retain every important detail. Leave generous quiet green margin around the motif; do not add a second panel or thumbnail.
Text: none.
Constraints: exactly one horse with anatomically correct four legs, no lettering, no monogram, no watermark, no app mockup, no rounded outer corners, no border, no collage, no scenery, no overly fine tiny details. Render the finished usable icon artwork, not a design presentation.
